Cultura Nova 
 - Adventurous singers wanted! BQN1778koenBroos 
 Adventurous singers wanted! 
Do you love singing and fancy taking part in an adventurous project? On Sunday 6 September, Cultura Nova , in collaboration with theatre maker Elsa van Dijk, will present THE EXPLODING WHALE MUSICAL . A cheerfully dark, slightly absurd parable for everyone aged 8 to 108. 
THE EXPLODING WHALE MUSICAL tells the story of a future society that believes it conquered the water years ago, but where a whale suddenly washes ashore. A visually striking musical theatre production performed on location around a life-size whale, featuring a local choir. 
And for this, we're looking for YOU! 
 We're looking for: - adventurous singers who fancy throwing themselves into an absurd universe. - of all ages and backgrounds; you don't need to speak perfect Dutch - if you can speak English, that's fine. It is important, however, that you're on your feet and can remember (simple) dance steps and cues. - who have experience of choral singing and the discipline and ability to learn music independently: you don't need to be able to read music - we'll provide you with recordings. - with a strong singing voice, a good ear for music and an affinity for acting - who are available on the following dates, times to be confirmed: - Saturday 29 August 2026 / rehearsal at Theater Heerlen from 1.00 pm to 5.30 pm - Sunday 6 September 2026 / run-through in the morning and performance at 3.30 pm on location 
You'll play a supporting role on stage and be coached by professional performers, including: Jonas Van Thielen, Elsa van Dijk and Joeri Cnapelinckx. Are you up for an unforgettable experience, sharing the stage with professional actors whilst getting to know new people at the same time? How to apply? - Send this, along with your contact details, to iris.vanhooren@culturanova.nl or via WhatsApp to 06-41872459
